reviews.title: This app is garbage.
reviews.text:
I regret not canceling this in time if you try the free trial, please please I beg you to cancel it in time. In fact do it after here is my experience.. I paid for a year of this app, and I regret it. I’ve now burned through about 10,000 credits trying to get a video that followed my prompt. The first 5,000 credits were gone in just two or three minutes. I understand there’s a learning curve with generative tools, and I expected to need a few attempts. But I explicitly said what I did not want, and those exact things appeared in every output. The results repeatedly ignored the clearest instructions I gave.

Accessing the generated video on my iPhone was another problem. I tried saving it to Files, but it never downloaded. It appeared in Photos, but I couldn’t select or access it in the app, even after trying multiple ways.

When I asked the assistant to look at the prompt already visible in the chat, it repeatedly said it couldn’t see it and asked me to paste it again. I got generic apologies and suggestions to try again, even though another attempt could use more credits.

After paying for an annual subscription, I was left with results that didn’t follow my instructions, a video I couldn’t use, and no useful support. The only thing this app has successfully helped me do is write this review. I would not recommend it. Please learn from my experience: don’t spend your money on it, and don’t download it. Other options you can choose from. This ain’t it.

For example, after uploading a patio photo and requesting the placement of two end tables, I was told to upload the original image again before it could proceed. I also attempted to complete the same task using Creative Studio without success. Rather than saving time, the service created additional work and frustration. The service failed to produce a usable result despite my following the requested steps. Because it did not meet my reasonable expectations for a key use case, I respectfully request that my refund be reconsidered.

reviews.title: ⚠️ BEWARE – THIS IS NOT A THREE-DAY FREE TRIAL
reviews.text:
Please be very careful before signing up for this so-called three-day free trial.

I signed up and cancelled on the very same day, yet I was also charged the full subscription price that same day. If something is advertised as a three-day free trial, I do not expect to be charged immediately.

Apple have now resolved the issue for me, but I am leaving this review to make other people aware.

Do not assume you have three free days before being charged. In my experience, I was charged immediately.

Please be aware of this before signing up.
………………………………………………….
Update following the developer’s delayed response: 2/10/26

Only now, after all this time, have you responded to my review. Calling what happened “confusion” does not address my complaint: I signed up for what was presented as a three-day free trial and was charged immediately.

Apple eventually refunded me after considerable time and effort. Apple resolved the charge; your company did not.

You say you “appreciate” my feedback, but I would have appreciated clear terms, no immediate charge during an advertised free trial, and a timely response. Passing my comments to your team does not explain why this happened or what you have changed to prevent it happening again.

Your response has not changed my view of the experience.

reviews.title: You can do it all in one place
reviews.text: I've been using chad Claude, da Vinci and all the AI apps since they first been coming out. And this morning I was browsing like we all do and I come across chat now and there Funnell. From what I understood you don’t have to go out of our application you can stay in one place and we can create it all for you in this one place so you don’t have to use all these different AI platforms we’re connected to them all so you just stay inside of our platform and we’ll do it for you. So give it a simple little task of saying I wanna create a video you want I'll give you all the specifications I link you to my website just kind of give me an idea of the product that I wanna do it for and the next thing I know. Being told to go into Canva and start uploading all my assets. Why am I going into Canva to upload my assets when your big selling point is you never have to leave our application because we handle it all we've got all the AI apps in one place and we're gonna take care of it for you right here so you don't have to jump back-and-forth between the all the ai apps - well call me a stuffed pig. Did I fall for it or what if I could do a minus one star I'll give it a minus one star beware people it does not stand up to everything that it says it's gonna do for you it's gonna tell you to go to different applications outside of its own app and have you man we used to in the old days before AI. Bye-bye chat now.
